meta.probingQuestion: What does your mask protect you from?
meta.connection: Your guard protects the space behind your legs. Your mask protects something too. Naming what the guard defends is the same as naming what the mask hides.
meta.takeaway: Tonight you worked from the hand fight, open guard, and mount. Your guard protects the space behind your legs, and your mask protects something in you too. Naming exactly what your mask guards is a skill, the same as naming what a good guard defends. You get to know your own mask well enough to use it on purpose.

slides.title: What does your mask protect you from?

items: The touch player wins with three sets of two touches in a row.
The clinch player wins by closing his own hands around the touch player, under both elbows or chest to back.
The top player wins by touching both of the bottom player's knee pits with his own leg, feet off the mat.
The bottom player wins by sitting up.
The top player holds as long as he keeps one of the bottom player's elbows covered.
The bottom player wins by touching both elbows to his body, or making the top player fall.
